facts.claim_ar: خطط Earth Engine التجارية: الأساسية 500$ شهريًا، والاحترافية 2,000$، والمميزة بالتواصل؛ والحوسبة 0.40$ لساعة EECU لأول 10 آلاف ساعة.
facts.safe_en: Commercial Earth Engine use is paid.

facts.claim_en: Government agencies may not use Earth Engine free of charge for internal R&D, prototyping or testing (except LDC, Indigenous or scholarly research cases).
facts.claim_ar: لا يجوز للجهات الحكومية استخدام Earth Engine مجانًا للبحث والتطوير الداخلي أو النماذج الأولية أو الاختبار (عدا حالات الدول الأقل نموًا والبحث العلمي).
facts.safe_en: A Jordanian utility pilot on Earth Engine would need a commercial licence.

facts.claim_en: Cloud Service Terms 5b: app end users may not access Earth Engine APIs unless they have their own GCP accounts with Earth Engine access.
facts.claim_ar: شروط Google Cloud البند 5ب: لا يصل مستخدمو التطبيق إلى واجهات Earth Engine إلا بحساباتهم الخاصة.
facts.safe_en: Crews using our app cannot call Earth Engine APIs directly unless each has their own Google Cloud account with Earth Engine access.

facts.claim_en: Google Open Buildings v3 does not cover Jordan: Jordan is absent from the 111-country list and 0 of 3,330 S2 level-6 data files intersect Jordan.
facts.claim_ar: لا تغطي مباني Google المفتوحة (الإصدار 3) الأردن: الأردن غير مدرج بين 111 دولة، ولا يتقاطع أي من 3,330 ملف بيانات مع الأردن.
facts.safe_en: Google Open Buildings has no data for Jordan.

facts.claim_en: Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (2016-2023) does not cover Jordan: 0 of 7,097 GeoTIFF tiles in the 2023 manifests for UTM 36N/37N intersect Jordan.
facts.claim_ar: لا تغطي مباني Google الزمنية 2.5D الأردن: لا يتقاطع أي من 7,097 بلاطة في فهارس 2023 لنطاقي UTM 36 و37 مع الأردن.
facts.safe_en: Google's building-change rasters do not cover Jordan.

facts.claim_en: Open Buildings is released under CC BY 4.0 and ODbL 1.0 (user chooses).
facts.claim_ar: تُنشر مباني Google المفتوحة بترخيصي CC BY 4.0 وODbL 1.0 والمستخدم يختار.
facts.safe_en: Open Buildings would be free to use if it covered Jordan.

facts.claim_en: Mapillary Terms 12: commercial use is allowed for improvement, training and development of products, algorithms and datasets, and for client services.
facts.claim_ar: شروط Mapillary البند 12: يُسمح بالاستخدام التجاري لتحسين المنتجات والخوارزميات ومجموعات البيانات وتدريبها وتطويرها، ولخدمة العملاء.
facts.safe_en: Mapillary's terms allow commercial use for training algorithms (Terms 12), with attribution and no re-identification; we would first need a free token.

facts.claim_en: Mapillary bbox queries must be smaller than 0.01 degrees square (changelog 2026-01-16) and need an access token.
facts.claim_ar: استعلامات Mapillary بالمربع المحيط يجب أن تكون أصغر من 0.01 درجة مربعة (2026-01-16) وتحتاج مفتاح وصول.
facts.safe_en: Mapillary corridor counts need a free developer token we did not create.

facts.claim_en: KartaView images are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 with the credit '(c) Grab and KartaView Contributors' (Terms last modified 2025-06-17).
facts.claim_ar: صور KartaView مرخصة CC BY-SA 4.0 مع الإسناد «© Grab and KartaView Contributors» (آخر تعديل للشروط 17 حزيران 2025).
facts.safe_en: KartaView street photos can be stored and shown with credit and share-alike.

facts.claim_en: KartaView photos within 60 m of the Desert Highway (Hwy 15, 268.7 km, Quweira-Amman): 21,336 in 27 segments, shot 2023-01-11 to 2023-03-23.
facts.claim_ar: صور KartaView ضمن 60 م من الطريق الصحراوي (طريق 15، 268.7 كم): 21,336 صورة في 27 مقطعًا، ملتقطة بين 11 كانون الثاني و23 آذار 2023.
facts.safe_en: Free street-level photos cover the whole Desert Highway, but only as one January-March 2023 capture campaign.

facts.claim_en: KartaView photos within 60 m of the Jordan Valley Highway (Hwy 65, 110.6 km, 31.75-32.70N): 15,769 in 12 segments, all shot 2023-01-11 to 2023-01-30.
facts.claim_ar: صور KartaView ضمن 60 م من طريق الأغوار (طريق 65، 110.6 كم): 15,769 صورة في 12 مقطعًا، كلها في كانون الثاني 2023.
facts.safe_en: Free street-level photos cover the Jordan Valley highway, from January 2023 captures only (11 and 29-30 Jan).

facts.claim_en: KartaView coverage tracks inside Jordan total 4,668.5 km (z10 coverage tiles, matched to OSM).
facts.claim_ar: مجموع مسارات تغطية KartaView داخل الأردن 4,668.5 كم.
facts.safe_en: KartaView has about 4,700 km of street imagery tracks in Jordan.

facts.claim_en: OSM API usage policy: the editing API is for editing, not for read-only projects.
facts.claim_ar: سياسة واجهة OSM: واجهة التحرير للتحرير لا لمشاريع القراءة فقط.
facts.safe_en: OSM bulk reads come from planet/extract files.

facts.claim_en: OSM Notes inside Jordan: 2,910 (2013-2026); 583 belong to one spam cluster in Ajloun (2021-07 to 2022-01); 8 relate to water assets; none reports a leak or theft.
facts.claim_ar: ملاحظات OSM داخل الأردن: 2,910 (2013-2026)؛ منها 583 رسالة عشوائية من موقع واحد في عجلون؛ 8 تتعلق بأصول مائية؛ ولا شيء عن تسرب أو سرقة.
facts.safe_en: Crowd map notes in Jordan are not a usable leak or theft signal.

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna takes water-quality complaints on 117116 and offers an online service to report a complaint or water theft.
facts.claim_ar: تتلقى مياهنا شكاوى نوعية المياه على الرقم 117116 وتوفر خدمة إلكترونية للتبليغ عن شكوى أو سرقة مياه.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna's public channels: call centre 117116, WhatsApp and an online theft-report form.
Miyahuna's complaints centre received about 1.74 million calls in 2023; the open-data file gives no breakdown by type or place.

facts.claim_en: X terms (effective 2026-10-09) prohibit crawling or scraping without prior written consent.
facts.claim_ar: تحظر شروط X (سارية 9 تشرين الأول 2026) الزحف أو الكشط دون موافقة خطية مسبقة.
facts.safe_en: Official social pages are read and cited by hand, never scraped.

facts.claim_en: Waze for Cities is open to authorities that manage traffic or public infrastructure.
facts.claim_ar: برنامج Waze for Cities متاح للجهات التي تدير المرور أو البنية التحتية العامة.
facts.safe_en: A water utility could apply to Waze for Cities; Missing Blue cannot alone.

facts.claim_en: Wikimapia content is CC BY-SA since May 2012 (per Wikipedia; Wikimapia's own terms could not be read).
facts.claim_ar: محتوى ويكيمابيا مرخص CC BY-SA منذ أيار 2012 (بحسب ويكيبيديا؛ لم تُقرأ شروط ويكيمابيا نفسها).
facts.safe_en: Wikimapia is reported as CC BY-SA, but we have not read its terms.

facts.claim_en: Google Street View in Jordan launched in November 2015 with 43 archaeological sites.
facts.claim_ar: أُطلق Street View في الأردن في تشرين الثاني 2015 بـ 43 موقعًا أثريًا.
facts.safe_en: Google Street View in Jordan is documented for heritage sites; road coverage is unverified.

facts.claim_en: Google Earth (Maps Platform plans) advertises historical satellite imagery since 1984.
facts.claim_ar: يعلن Google Earth (الخطط المهنية) عن صور فضائية تاريخية منذ 1984.
facts.safe_en: Google Earth historical imagery can help analysts look back at a site, by eye only.

facts.claim_en: Terms versions unchanged since the 2026-09-14 review: ToS 2026-08-26, SST 2026-06-10, Analytics SST 2026-09-03.
facts.claim_ar: لم تتغير نسخ الشروط منذ مراجعة 14 أيلول 2026: الشروط العامة 26 آب، والخاصة 10 حزيران، والتحليلات 3 أيلول 2026.
facts.safe_en: Google's map terms we rely on were re-read on 2026-10-09 and are unchanged since September.

facts.claim_en: Earth Search Collection-1 (sentinel-2-c1-l2a) has no Sentinel-2 scenes over the 5 AOIs for the Jul 1-Sep 15 windows of 2017, 2022.
facts.claim_ar: لا تحتوي مجموعة Sentinel-2 المجموعة 1 في Earth Search على أي مشهد للمناطق الخمس في نافذة 1 تموز-15 أيلول لعامي 2017 و2022.
facts.safe_en: For 2017 and 2022 we used the older sentinel-2-l2a collection and put it on the same reflectance scale.

facts.claim_en: In Earth Search's sentinel-2-l2a collection, COG pixel values of PB 05.00 items are exactly 1000 DN lower than the same datatake in sentinel-2-c1-l2a, although both assets declare raster:bands offset -0.1: the +1000 offset was already removed from sentinel-2-l2a COGs.
facts.claim_ar: في مجموعة sentinel-2-l2a على Earth Search قيم البكسل أقل بـ1000 تماماً من نفس المشهد في المجموعة 1 رغم أن البيانات الوصفية لكليهما تقول offset = -0.1؛ أي أن الإزاحة أُزيلت مسبقاً.
facts.safe_en: Older Sentinel-2 files on AWS mislabel their brightness offset; we measured it and put every year on one scale.

facts.claim_en: 2022 sentinel-2-l2a items (PB 04.00) flagged earthsearch:boa_offset_applied=False also carry no +1000 offset in their COG pixels (about 1000 DN below Collection-1 for the same ground in 2021 and 2023).
facts.claim_ar: عناصر 2022 (خط المعالجة 04.00) المعلَّمة boa_offset_applied=False لا تحمل الإزاحة أيضاً (أقل بنحو 1000 من المجموعة 1 لنفس الأرض في 2021 و2023).
facts.safe_en: All 2017-2026 images are on one reflectance scale; the correction was measured, not assumed.

facts.claim_en: Collection-1 reprocessing (PB 05.00) makes bare-desert reflectance slightly brighter than the original processing of the same datatake (after removing the offset).
facts.claim_ar: إعادة المعالجة (المجموعة 1) تجعل انعكاسية الصحراء أعلى قليلاً من المعالجة الأصلية لنفس المشهد (بعد إزالة الإزاحة).
facts.safe_en: Small processing differences (about 1-2 % in brightness) remain between years; the change test uses thresholds well above them.

facts.claim_en: From 25 Jan 2022 (processing baseline 04.00) Sentinel-2 L2A data carry an offset that must be applied to compare with earlier data.
facts.claim_ar: منذ 25 كانون الثاني 2022 (خط المعالجة 04.00) تحمل بيانات Sentinel-2 إزاحة يجب تطبيقها للمقارنة مع البيانات الأقدم.
facts.safe_en: Sentinel-2 changed its brightness encoding in January 2022; our stack corrects for it.

facts.claim_en: Most Jul-Sep 2023 Sentinel-2 scenes over the AOIs exist only as processing baseline 05.09, which Earth Search v2 excludes from Collection 1.
facts.claim_ar: معظم مشاهد تموز-أيلول 2023 للمناطق متاحة فقط بخط المعالجة 05.09 الذي يستبعده الإصدار 2 من Earth Search من المجموعة 1.
facts.value: 96% of 220 C1 items in 2023 are PB 05.09
facts.safe_en: 2023 images come from an interim processing version; values are on the same scale but should be re-pulled when ESA reprocesses them.

facts.claim_en: July and August are rain-free in every Jordanian governorate (CHIRPS 2015-2025 monthly means), so a Jul 1-Sep 15 window compares like with like.
facts.claim_ar: تموز وآب بلا مطر تقريباً في كل المحافظات (متوسطات CHIRPS 2015-2025)، فنافذة 1 تموز-15 أيلول تقارن المتشابه.
facts.value: Jul max 0.03 mm; Aug max 0.03 mm; Sep max 0.66 mm
facts.safe_en: The comparison uses the rain-free months (July to mid-September) of every year.

facts.claim_en: Clear dry-season Sentinel-2 scenes are available every year 2017-2026 for all 5 AOIs: two scenes per AOI-year were selected from SCL over the AOI itself.
facts.claim_ar: تتوفر مشاهد Sentinel-2 صافية في الموسم الجاف كل عام 2017-2026 للمناطق الخمس؛ اختير مشهدان لكل منطقة وسنة بالاعتماد على طبقة SCL فوق المنطقة نفسها.
facts.value: 100 scenes; 99 with >=99.5% valid AOI pixels; min 99.249%
facts.safe_en: Cloud is not a constraint in the Jordanian summer desert: 10 years x 5 sites of clear images were found.

facts.claim_en: Summer scenes over the northern Jordan Valley (aoi-04) are often partly cloud-flagged by SCL, unlike the desert AOIs.
facts.claim_ar: مشاهد الصيف فوق شمال الأغوار (aoi-04) كثيراً ما تحمل علامات غيوم في SCL بخلاف مناطق الصحراء.
facts.value: aoi-04: 18 of 37 screened scenes < 99.5% valid (min 51.353%); desert AOIs: 17 of 97
facts.safe_en: The Jordan Valley needs more image dates per year than the desert.

facts.claim_en: Brief: Sentinel-2 satellite images are free.
facts.claim_ar: الموجز: صور Sentinel-2 مجانية.
facts.safe_en: Sentinel-2 imagery is free and open; we downloaded 10 years for five sites without any account.
facts.publisher: AWS Registry of Open Data / ESA

facts.claim_en: WorldCover 2021 land-cover shares of the AOIs (corridors domain, aois.csv) re-computed on the exact bbox clipped to Jordan.
facts.claim_ar: نسب الغطاء الأرضي WorldCover 2021 للمناطق (من مجال الممرات) أعيد حسابها على حدود المربعات الدقيقة داخل الأردن.
facts.value: aoi-01 ours {'bare': 97.6, 'grass': 0.8, 'crop': 0.8, 'tree': 0.0} | corridors {bare 97.6, grass 0.7, crop 0.8, tree 0.0} ; aoi-02 ours {'bare': 97.8, 'grass': 2.1, 'crop': 0.2, 'tree': 0.0} | corridors {bare 97.8, grass 2.0, crop 0.2, tree None} ; aoi-03 ours {'bare': 99.4, 'grass': 0.6, 'crop': 0.0, 'tree': 0.0} | corridors {bare 99.4, grass 0.6, crop 0.0, tree None} ; aoi-04 ours {'bare': 1.3, 'grass': 56.5, 'crop': 13.8, 'tree': 21.5} | corridors {bare 1.3, grass 56.5, crop 13.8, tree 21.5} ; aoi-05 ours {'bare': 95.8, 'grass': 0.4, 'crop': 3.6, 'tree': 0.0} | corridors {bare 95.8, grass 0.4, crop 3.6, tree 0.0}
facts.safe_en: The desert test sites are about 96-99% bare ground (ESA WorldCover 2021).

facts.claim_en: Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level-2 dry-season scenes 2013-2016 can be fetched anonymously from Microsoft Planetary Computer (anonymous SAS token, no account).
facts.claim_ar: يمكن تنزيل مشاهد لاندسات 8 (المجموعة 2 المستوى 2) للمواسم الجافة 2013-2016 دون حساب من Planetary Computer.
facts.safe_en: Free Landsat images extend the history back to 2013 at 30 m.

facts.claim_en: First-appearance test (NDVI >= 0.25 in a dry-season composite, never green in any earlier year, 2019-2026): new green patches of at least 1 ha per AOI.
facts.claim_ar: اختبار الظهور الأول (NDVI ≥ 0.25 في مركّب الموسم الجاف ولم يكن أخضر في أي سنة سابقة، 2019-2026): عدد البقع الخضراء الجديدة ≥ 1 هكتار لكل منطقة.
facts.value: aoi-01: 37 patches >=1 ha, 2 >=10 ha, 180 ha total ; aoi-02: 117 patches >=1 ha, 6 >=10 ha, 471 ha total ; aoi-03: 0 patches >=1 ha, 0 >=10 ha, 0 ha total ; aoi-04: 196 patches >=1 ha, 1 >=10 ha, 1330 ha total ; aoi-05: 81 patches >=1 ha, 38 >=10 ha, 1776 ha total
facts.safe_en: A simple, standard comparison of dry-season images flags new green patches every year; each is only 'worth inspecting'.

facts.claim_en: Positive control: the Sentinel-2 first-appearance test independently flags the new irrigated patches that FAO WaPOR evapotranspiration found near Mudawwara (landcover_agri domain).
facts.claim_ar: ضبط موجب: اختبار الظهور الأول بصور Sentinel-2 يلتقط بشكل مستقل البقع المروية الجديدة التي وجدتها بيانات WaPOR قرب المدورة.
facts.value: 15 of 23 WaPOR patches (1805 of 2166 ha) have >=20% of pixels flagged new-green (area-weighted flagged share 0.52); of these, the S2 first year equals WaPOR's first summer-irrigated year in 11 of 15 and is within 1 year in 12. Of the other 8, 7 practically never reach NDVI 0.25 in the dry-season composites (<=1% of their pixels in any year: ET rise from other seasons or sparse cover); patch 660 (7.2 ha): 55% of its pixels green in some year, 49% already green in the 2017-2018 baseline (never countable as new), 6% flagged new.
facts.safe_en: On known new farms in the southern desert, the image comparison finds most of them (15 of 23, 83% of the area) and, for most of those, the year they appeared (11 of 15).
facts.publisher: computed (this run) vs landcover_agri (FAO WaPOR v3)

facts.claim_en: Brief: nobody has tested whether satellite images can spot these patches in Jordan.
facts.claim_ar: الموجز: لم يختبر أحد إن كانت صور الأقمار تكشف هذه البقع في الأردن.
facts.value: tested for new irrigated patches (farm scale); untested for leak-size wet patches
facts.safe_en: Free images clearly show new farm-sized green patches in open desert (15 of 23 known new irrigated patches, 83% of their area); whether small leaks show up is the next test, with field checks.

facts.claim_en: Share of each AOI bbox that lies outside Jordan (OSM admin boundaries).
facts.claim_ar: نسبة كل مربع اختبار الواقعة خارج الأردن (حدود OSM الإدارية).
facts.safe_en: The Jordan Valley test box was trimmed to Jordan's side of the river for all counts.

facts.claim_en: Bare-desert background NDVI of the yearly composites moves by a few hundredths between years (atmosphere / processing), largest in 2022.
facts.claim_ar: خلفية NDVI للصحراء الجرداء في المركّبات السنوية تتحرك ببضعة أجزاء من المئة بين السنوات (الغلاف الجوي/المعالجة)، وأكبرها في 2022.
facts.unit: NDVI deviation from the AOI's 2017-2026 median of yearly medians
facts.safe_en: Year-to-year noise in desert brightness is small compared with a real new green patch.

facts.claim_en: New green patches of at least 1 ha (2019-2026) in the three Disi-corridor AOIs, and how many lie near the mapped (restricted, approximate) corridor line.
facts.claim_ar: البقع الخضراء الجديدة ≥ 1 هكتار (2019-2026) في مناطق ممر الديسي الثلاث، وكم منها قريب من خط الممر المرسوم (مقيّد وتقريبي).
facts.safe_en: In the three Disi test boxes (not the whole line), only a handful of new green patches of 1 ha or more appear per year near the line - few enough for crews to check each one.

facts.claim_en: Microsoft Planetary Computer already serves reprocessed (PB 05.10) Sentinel-2 L2A for summer 2022, which Earth Search lacks in Collection 1.
facts.claim_ar: يوفّر Planetary Computer صور صيف 2022 معاد معالجتها (05.10) التي تنقص المجموعة 1 في Earth Search.
facts.safe_en: A second free mirror can fill the 2022 gap with harmonised data if needed.

facts.claim_en: Verifier note (2026-10-10): pre-Collection-1 processing turns negative reflectance into nodata, so the two collections treat dark pixels differently.
facts.claim_ar: ملاحظة المدقق: المعالجة السابقة للمجموعة 1 تجعل الانعكاسية السالبة بلا بيانات، فتختلف المجموعتان في البكسلات الداكنة.
facts.value: 2022-07-29 (aoi-04, sentinel-2-l2a PB 04.00;04.00): of 9136 SCL-water pixels, 1891 have B08 at the floor 0.0001-0.0003 and 0 are nodata; Collection-1 scenes keep 13455 clear pixels with reflectance <= 0 in B04/B08/B11 (sentinel-2-l2a scenes: 0)
facts.safe_en: Very dark pixels are clipped by one rule in all ten years, so they are treated the same way in every year.

facts.claim_en: Dark-target guard: NDVI/NDMI are left undefined where B08 < 0.05 (open water, very dark surfaces); the 'green' pixels it removes are almost all water or very dark non-vegetated surfaces.
facts.claim_ar: حارس الأهداف الداكنة: يُترك NDVI/NDMI بلا قيمة حيث B08 < 0.05 (ماء مكشوف أو سطح داكن جداً)؛ والبكسلات «الخضراء» التي يزيلها كلها تقريباً ماء أو أسطح داكنة غير نباتية.
facts.value: 199569 of 420207111 clear scene pixels (0.047%), 61% of them SCL water; per AOI share of clear pixels: aoi-01 0.010%; aoi-02 0.001%; aoi-03 0.000%; aoi-04 0.387%; aoi-05 0.002%; per-scene green pixels (NDVI >= 0.25) removed: aoi-01 2215 of 154821; aoi-02 7 of 175000; aoi-03 0 of 149; aoi-04 12287 of 16054585; aoi-05 178 of 864715; of the 14687 removed 'green' pixels, SCL calls 58% water, 30% not-vegetated and 0.5% vegetation
facts.unit: pixels (10 m), summed over the 100 scenes
facts.safe_en: Open water and very dark surfaces (near-infrared reflectance below 0.05) are left out of the vegetation index; none of the new green patches of 1 ha or more is a dark or water surface.

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna's network is pressurised about 22% of the week (~37-38 hours) in 2024; Yarmouk 5.4% (~9 h); Aqaba 100%.
facts.claim_ar: شبكة مياهنا مضغوطة نحو 22% من وقت الأسبوع (نحو 37-38 ساعة) في 2024، واليرموك 5.4% (نحو 9 ساعات)، والعقبة 100%.
facts.safe_en: Official utility reporting puts Amman-area supply at roughly 38 hours a week and the north at about 9 hours.

facts.claim_en: Continuity is defined as hours per week the system is pressurised divided by 168.
facts.claim_ar: تعريف الاستمرارية: ساعات الضغط الأسبوعية مقسومة على 168.
facts.safe_en: Hours/week = continuity % x 168 (UPMU definition).

facts.claim_en: UPMU warns continuity figures reflect the utilities' schedules, not measured supply; no-water complaints rise in summer.
facts.claim_ar: تحذر الوحدة من أن أرقام الاستمرارية تعكس جداول الشركات لا التزويد الفعلي، وأن شكاوى عدم وصول المياه ترتفع صيفاً.
facts.safe_en: Reported supply hours are schedules; summer complaint peaks suggest some households get less than scheduled.

facts.claim_en: UPMU: peak complaints at peak consumption could indicate inequitable summer distribution - some subscribers' high use leaves others short.
facts.claim_ar: الوحدة: تزامن ذروة الشكاوى مع ذروة الاستهلاك قد يدل على توزيع غير عادل صيفاً يترك مشتركين آخرين بلا مياه كافية.
facts.safe_en: The regulator itself flags unequal summer distribution: heavy users upstream can leave others short.

facts.claim_en: 'No water' complaints per 1,000 active subscribers in 2024: Miyahuna 255, Aqaba Water 179, Yarmouk Water 252.
facts.claim_ar: شكاوى عدم وصول المياه لكل 1000 مشترك فعّال في 2024: مياهنا 255، العقبة 179، اليرموك 252.
facts.safe_en: In 2024 roughly one 'no water' complaint was logged for every four active subscribers in Miyahuna and Yarmouk areas.

facts.claim_en: In 2020 Zarqa had 433 'no water' complaints per 1,000 subscribers vs 270 in Amman and 181 in Madaba.
facts.claim_ar: في 2020 بلغت شكاوى عدم وصول المياه في الزرقاء 433 لكل 1000 مشترك مقابل 270 في عمّان و181 في مادبا.
facts.safe_en: Zarqa is the worst-served Miyahuna governorate by complaint rate (2020).

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna's control centre received 207,948 'no water' complaints and 103,488 pipe-break complaints in 2025.
facts.claim_ar: استقبل مركز التحكم في مياهنا 207,948 شكوى عدم وصول مياه و103,488 شكوى كسور في 2025.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna logged about 208,000 'no water' and 103,000 break complaints in 2025.

facts.claim_en: Amman network: 9,511 main-line breaks and 46,609 house-connection breaks in 2025 (56,120 repairs, 10,998 km).
facts.claim_ar: شبكة عمّان: 9,511 كسراً على الخطوط الرئيسية و46,609 كسراً على الوصلات المنزلية في 2025.
facts.safe_en: Amman's 11,000 km network had about 9,500 main-line breaks in 2025 - roughly 26 a day.

facts.claim_en: Average response time to break complaints in Amman fell from 7.35 h (2000) to 1 h (2022-2023).
facts.claim_ar: انخفض متوسط زمن الاستجابة لشكاوى الكسور في عمّان من 7.35 ساعة (2000) إلى ساعة واحدة (2022-2023).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna reports about 1 hour average response to break complaints (2022-23).

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna's 'speed of repair' (bursts repaired within target time) dropped to 87% in 2024 from 98% in 2023.
facts.claim_ar: انخفضت نسبة إصلاح الكسور ضمن الزمن المستهدف في مياهنا إلى 87% في 2024 من 98% في 2023.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna fixed 87% of bursts within target time in 2024 (98% in 2023).

facts.claim_en: 50.3% of Jordanians get water 24 hours a week or less; 49.7% get 24-48 hours a week.
facts.claim_ar: 50.3% من الأردنيين يحصلون على المياه 24 ساعة أسبوعياً أو أقل، و49.7% بين 24 و48 ساعة.
facts.safe_en: MWI estimates about half of Jordanians receive piped water for 24 hours a week or less.

facts.claim_en: Intermittent supply (all of Jordan except Aqaba) cycles pipes between no pressure and over-pressure, increasing bursts, and leaves only a few pressurised hours a week to find leaks.
facts.claim_ar: التزويد المتقطع (في كل الأردن عدا العقبة) يعرّض الأنابيب لتناوب انعدام الضغط وارتفاعه فيزيد الكسور، ويترك ساعات قليلة أسبوعياً لاكتشاف التسرب.
facts.safe_en: The World Bank links Jordan's intermittent supply to more pipe bursts and fewer hours to detect leaks.

facts.claim_en: In drought periods such as 2021 and 2022, rationing reduces service to as low as 70 litres per person per day (World Bank).
facts.claim_ar: في فترات الجفاف مثل 2021 و2022 يخفّض التقنين الخدمة إلى ما يصل إلى 70 لتراً للفرد يومياً (البنك الدولي).
facts.safe_en: The World Bank says that in drought years such as 2021 and 2022, rationing can cut supply to as little as 70 litres per person per day.

facts.claim_en: In Amman water is available only 12-24 hours each week.
facts.claim_ar: في عمّان تتوفر المياه 12-24 ساعة أسبوعياً فقط.
facts.safe_en: Amman households typically receive piped water one to two days a week (sources range 12-38 hours).

facts.claim_en: National water supply was 126 l/c/d in 2022 (water supplied; the table gives no definition).
facts.claim_ar: بلغ التزويد الوطني 126 لتر/فرد/يوم في 2022 (مياه مزوّدة؛ الجدول لا يعرّفها).
facts.safe_en: MWI reports average water supply of about 126 litres per person per day in 2022; this is water put into the system, about half of which MWI estimates as non-revenue water.

facts.claim_en: Northern governorates per-capita share: Irbid 74, Mafraq 118, Jerash 91, Ajloun 86 l/day.
facts.claim_ar: حصة الفرد في محافظات الشمال: إربد 74، المفرق 118، جرش 91، عجلون 86 لتراً يومياً.
facts.safe_en: Irbid's per-capita share (~74 l/day in a 2020 table; definition not stated) is roughly 60% of the national average supply for the same year (125 l/c/d in 2020).

facts.claim_en: Balqa 2020: 223 l/c/d supplied with losses but only 63.3 l/c/d without losses; NRW 71.3%.
facts.claim_ar: البلقاء 2020: 223 لتر/فرد/يوم مع الفاقد و63.3 فقط بدون الفاقد؛ نسبة الفاقد 71.3%.
facts.safe_en: In Balqa (2020) over 70% of the water supplied was recorded as lost (non-revenue water 71.3%).

facts.claim_en: Within Balqa (2023), Salt gets ~312 l/c/d net supply (incl. losses) vs ~157 in Ain Al-Basha (derived from population and supply).
facts.claim_ar: داخل البلقاء (2023) يصل السلط نحو 312 لتر/فرد/يوم صافي تزويد (شاملاً الفاقد) مقابل نحو 157 في عين الباشا (محسوب).
facts.safe_en: Supply per person differs about two-fold between neighbouring districts of Balqa (derived from Miyahuna figures).

facts.claim_en: WAJ Internal Control Unit received 1,136 citizen complaints in 2024 (no water, line breaks, poor distribution, sewer).
facts.claim_ar: استقبلت وحدة الرقابة الداخلية في سلطة المياه 1136 شكوى في 2024 (عدم وصول مياه، كسر خطوط، سوء توزيع، صرف صحي).
facts.safe_en: WAJ's Internal Control Unit handled about 1,100 citizen complaints in 2024.

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna pressure management covers 16 of 47 distribution zones in the capital.
facts.claim_ar: إدارة الضغط تغطي 16 منطقة توزيع من أصل 47 في العاصمة.
facts.safe_en: Only about a third of Amman's 47 distribution zones are under pressure management (2025).

facts.claim_en: Yarmouk Water loses 6,955 litres per connection per day (Al-Rkebat 2026).
facts.claim_ar: تفقد مياه اليرموك 6955 لتراً لكل وصلة يومياً (دراسة 2026).
facts.safe_en: Do not use. Official UPMU figure: about 0.6 m3 lost per connection per day in Yarmouk's area.

facts.claim_en: MCC: network rehabilitation raised reported pressure; treated households got more hours/week than controls in Amman but not in Zarqa.
facts.claim_ar: مؤسسة تحدي الألفية: رفع تأهيل الشبكة الضغط المبلّغ عنه، وحصلت الأسر المستفيدة على ساعات أكثر في عمّان لا في الزرقاء.
facts.safe_en: MCC's interim evaluation (2019) found higher reported pressure in rehabilitated areas; treated households got more supply hours than controls in Amman but not in Zarqa, possibly because supply rose for all of Zarqa.

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna rented private wells reaching 3,000 m3/h for the capital by end-2025 to cover shortages.
facts.claim_ar: استأجرت مياهنا آباراً خاصة وصلت كمياتها إلى 3000 م3/ساعة في العاصمة نهاية 2025 لتغطية النقص.
facts.safe_en: By end-2025 Miyahuna was renting private wells (~3,000 m3/h) to plug supply gaps in Amman.

facts.claim_en: The Ain Ghazal carrier break by a contractor (FORCAST prior row AMM-INC-022, date uncertain) happened on 2022-08-01.
facts.claim_ar: كسر الخط الناقل في عين غزال بآليات مقاول (صف سابق بتاريخ غير مؤكد) وقع في 1/8/2022.
facts.safe_en: On 1 Aug 2022 a contractor broke a main carrier at Ain Ghazal, cutting supply to Shmeisani, Arjan and nearby areas.

facts.claim_en: Aqaba Water pumps to homes around the clock and has not issued a rotation (distribution) programme.
facts.claim_ar: شركة مياه العقبة تضخ المياه للمنازل على مدار الساعة ولم تصدر برنامج توزيع.
facts.safe_en: Of the three water companies, only Aqaba Water reports continuous (24/7) supply (UPMU continuity 100%, 2020-2024).

facts.claim_en: MWI topped Bekhedmetkom complaints among ministries in Jan-Sep 2022 (3,016; 8.2%).
facts.claim_ar: تصدرت وزارة المياه شكاوى منصة بخدمتكم على الوزارات منذ بداية 2022 حتى أيلول (3016 شكوى، 8.2%).
facts.safe_en: Water was the most-complained-about ministry on the government complaints platform between January and mid-September 2022 (news report of official data).

facts.claim_en: Zara-Ma'in pumping (about 20% of Amman's supply) is suspended several times each winter because of turbidity.
facts.claim_ar: يتوقف الضخ من الزارة-ماعين (نحو 20% من تزويد عمّان) مرات عدة كل شتاء بسبب العكورة.
facts.safe_en: Rain-borne turbidity has halted the Zara-Ma'in plant, which serves parts of Amman and Madaba, in most years since 2018.

facts.claim_en: Contractor / third-party works are the most-cited stated cause of reported main breaks (FORCAST prior finding: 4 of 7 Amman water rows).
facts.claim_ar: أعمال المقاولين والجهات الأخرى أكثر سبب معلن لكسور الخطوط الرئيسية المنشورة.
facts.unit: main-break events with a stated external cause
facts.safe_en: Among reported main breaks with a stated cause, contractor and third-party works are frequent - a news sample, not a utility statistic.

facts.claim_en: MWI recorded 6,616 attacks on water networks across Jordan in the first half of 2026 (same figure in the MWI infographic PDF).
facts.claim_ar: سجلت وزارة المياه 6616 اعتداء على شبكات المياه في النصف الأول من 2026.
facts.safe_en: MWI counted about 6,600 attacks on water networks in the first half of 2026.

facts.claim_en: Regional split of the H1-2026 attacks: North 779, Middle 5,328, South 509.
facts.claim_ar: توزيع اعتداءات النصف الأول 2026: الشمال 779، الوسط 5328، الجنوب 509.
facts.safe_en: About four in five recorded network attacks in H1-2026 were in the central region.

facts.claim_en: MWI recorded 13,796 attacks on the Disi conveyor from 2014 to mid-August 2026.
facts.claim_ar: سجلت الوزارة 13,796 اعتداء على خط الديسي من 2014 حتى منتصف آب 2026.
facts.safe_en: Nearly 14,000 attacks on the Disi line were recorded between 2014 and August 2026.

facts.claim_en: 2025 was the peak year for attacks on the Disi line: 1,853 attacks (spokesperson, 11 Aug 2026).
facts.claim_ar: عام 2025 الأعلى في الاعتداءات على الديسي: 1853 اعتداء.
facts.safe_en: 2025 was the worst year on the Disi line, with about 1,800 recorded attacks.

facts.claim_en: More than 14,000 attacks on water networks and sources were recorded in 2025, losing more than 27 MCM.
facts.claim_ar: أكثر من 14 ألف اعتداء على شبكات ومصادر المياه خلال 2025 وخسارة أكثر من 27 مليون م3.
facts.safe_en: The water sector logged over 14,000 attacks in 2025, costing more than 27 million cubic metres.

facts.claim_en: From June 2013 to June 2026 MWI recorded 133,408 attacks on main and carrier lines (with 1,734 wells backfilled and 38,667 canal attacks in the same release).
facts.claim_ar: من حزيران 2013 حتى حزيران 2026: 133,408 اعتداءات على الخطوط الرئيسية والناقلة.
facts.safe_en: Since mid-2013 the ministry has recorded about 133,000 attacks on main and carrier lines.

facts.claim_en: Brief figure: 59,630 attempts to breach pipelines and 24,615 on the King Abdullah Canal (2013 - April 2021), and 1,213 illegal wells shut.
facts.claim_ar: رقم الموجز: 59,630 اعتداء على الخطوط و24,615 على قناة الملك عبدالله (2013 - نيسان 2021) وإغلاق 1,213 بئرا.
facts.safe_en: By April 2021 MWI had logged 59,630 pipeline breaches; by June 2026 the count had passed 133,000.

facts.claim_ar: السلسلة الرسمية لعدد الآبار المخالفة المردومة 2013-2023.
facts.safe_en: MWI's own yearly table shows illegal-well backfilling peaked in 2014 (562) and fell to 37 in 2020.

facts.claim_en: 137 illegal wells were backfilled in 2018.
facts.claim_ar: ردم 137 بئرا مخالفة في 2018.
facts.safe_en: MWI publications put 2018 backfilled wells between 111 and 249.

facts.claim_en: 1,049 illegal wells had been backfilled by early 2023.
facts.claim_ar: ردم 1049 بئرا مخالفة حتى مطلع 2023.
facts.safe_en: MWI figures for illegal wells backfilled since 2013 range from about 1,050 (press release, early 2023) to about 1,580 (its own yearly table, 2013-2022), depending on the publication.

facts.claim_en: About 70% of water losses are due to theft and attacks on lines (MWI spokesperson).
facts.claim_ar: نحو 70% من فاقد المياه يعود إلى السرقات والاعتداءات.
facts.safe_en: MWI attributes roughly 70% of non-revenue water to theft and illegal use.

facts.claim_en: 873 attacks on the King Abdullah Canal were caught from January to May 2025, saving about 226,000 m3.
facts.claim_ar: ضبط 873 اعتداء على قناة الملك عبدالله من بداية 2025 حتى نهاية أيار.
facts.safe_en: Canal patrols removed 873 illegal draws in the first five months of 2025.

facts.claim_en: 19,596 attacks on water sources, lines, treasury lands and the King Abdullah Canal were caught in 2024.
facts.claim_ar: ضبط 19,596 اعتداء على مصادر وخطوط المياه وأراضي الخزينة والقناة في 2024.
facts.safe_en: Close to 20,000 water-related attacks were dealt with in 2024.

facts.claim_en: In July 2026 MWI removed 19 major taps on 8- and 16-inch transmission mains in Aqaba selling about 3,500 m3 a day to factories and hotels.
facts.claim_ar: ضبط 19 اعتداء كبيرا على خطوط ناقلة 8 و16 إنش في العقبة تبيع نحو 3500 م3 يوميا.
facts.safe_en: A July 2026 raid in Aqaba found 19 illegal taps on transmission mains selling about 3,500 m3 a day.

facts.claim_en: The Aqaba offender earned JD 17 million from selling water in six months.
facts.claim_ar: المعتدي على المياه في العقبة حصّل 17 مليون دينار خلال 6 أشهر.
facts.safe_en: Officials described the Aqaba case as a major economic crime; the reported earnings figures are inconsistent.

facts.claim_en: An air valve on the Disi line at Al-Jafr was broken (detected 6 Aug 2026) to fill tankers, leaking about 5,000 m3 a day.
facts.claim_ar: كسر هواية رئيسية على خط الديسي في الجفر وتسرب نحو 5 آلاف م3 يوميا.
facts.safe_en: A broken air valve on the Disi line near Al-Jafr leaked about 5,000 m3 a day in August 2026.

facts.claim_en: Disi attacks in 2026: 780 (January-May), 321 (June), 343 (July).
facts.claim_ar: اعتداءات الديسي 2026: 780 حتى أيار، 321 في حزيران، 343 في تموز.
facts.safe_en: Attacks on the Disi line ran at roughly 330-350 a month in mid-2026.

facts.claim_en: Estimated water-theft losses were 9.58 MCM in 2022.
facts.claim_ar: قدرت خسائر سرقة المياه في 2022 بنحو 9.58 مليون م3.
facts.safe_en: MWI estimated 2022 water-theft losses at about 9.6 million cubic metres.

facts.claim_en: 49 illegal wells were backfilled near Kafrain dam on 21 February 2023 (largest single raid found).
facts.claim_ar: ردم 49 بئرا مخالفة قرب سد الكفرين في 21 شباط 2023.
facts.safe_en: A February 2023 raid near Kafrain dam backfilled 49 illegal wells selling water to hotels and farms.

facts.claim_en: From January to early October 2024: 10,260 main-line attacks, 92 wells backfilled, 6 rigs seized, 35 MCM saved.
facts.claim_ar: حتى مطلع تشرين الأول 2024: 10260 اعتداء على الخطوط الرئيسية و92 بئرا و6 حفارات.
facts.safe_en: In the first nine months of 2024 MWI removed more than 10,000 attacks on main lines.

facts.claim_en: January to early November 2025: 11,519 main lines, 68 wells, 22 rigs, 2,653 canal attacks; 31.5 MCM saved.
facts.claim_ar: حتى مطلع تشرين الثاني 2025: 11519 خطا رئيسيا و68 بئرا و22 حفارة و2653 اعتداء على القناة.
facts.safe_en: MWI says its 2025 campaign recovered about 31.5 million cubic metres by November.

facts.claim_en: Cumulative 1 June 2013 - November 2025: 122,897 line attacks, 1,683 wells, 37,301 canal attacks.
facts.claim_ar: الحصيلة منذ 1/6/2013 حتى تشرين الثاني 2025: 122897 اعتداء و1683 بئرا و37301 على القناة.
facts.safe_en: By late 2025 the campaign total passed 122,000 line attacks.

facts.claim_en: Network attacks in Amman doubled in Q1-2023: 1,457 against 730 in Q1-2022 (Miyahuna).
facts.claim_ar: تضاعف الاعتداءات في عمّان في الربع الأول 2023: 1457 مقابل 730.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna reported twice as many network attacks in Amman in early 2023 as a year before.

facts.claim_en: The Disi conveyor suffered 61 attacks from January to June 2019 and 188 in July 2019 alone.
facts.claim_ar: 61 اعتداء على الديسي حتى 30/6/2019 و188 خلال تموز 2019.
facts.safe_en: MWI counted 61 attacks on the Disi conveyor in the first half of 2019, then 188 on the whole Disi system in July 2019 alone.

facts.claim_en: Year-to-date to June 2026: 476 King Abdullah Canal attacks and 24 illegal wells seized (MWI infographic).
facts.claim_ar: حتى حزيران 2026: 476 اعتداء على قناة الملك عبدالله و24 بئرا مخالفة.
facts.safe_en: MWI reported about 480 canal attacks and two dozen illegal wells in the first half of 2026.

facts.claim_en: Jordan loses 41% of the water it produces (2026) [brief §1]
facts.claim_ar: الأردن يفقد 41% من المياه التي ينتجها (2026)
facts.safe_en: Jordan's non-revenue water (water produced but not billed) is about 41-45%: 45.0% in the official Jul-2024-Jun-2025 assessment, and the ministry cites ~41-42% in 2026.
facts.publisher: Minister of Water (via Akhbarna); MWI spokesperson (via Al-Ghad); JICA 2026

facts.claim_en: National NRW target is 25% by 2040 [brief §1]
facts.claim_ar: الهدف الوطني للفاقد 25% بحلول 2040
facts.safe_en: Jordan's national target is to cut non-revenue water to 25% by 2040 (interim 34% by 2030).

facts.claim_en: About half of the loss is physical leaks; the other half is administrative (theft, unbilled water, meter errors) [brief §1, attributed to GIZ]
facts.claim_ar: نحو نصف الفاقد تسرب فيزيائي والنصف الآخر إداري (سرقة، مياه غير مفوترة، أخطاء عدادات)
facts.safe_en: Estimates of the split vary: most sources put physical leakage at roughly 40-50% of non-revenue water and commercial losses (theft, meter error, unbilled use) at 50-60%; the Central NRW Unit estimates illegal use alone at about 70%. No GIZ source for an exact half-half split was found.

facts.claim_en: National NRW fell from 51.7% (FY2021/22) to 45.0% (FY2024/25)
facts.claim_ar: انخفض الفاقد الوطني من 51.7% إلى 45.0%
facts.safe_en: Official national NRW was 45.0% in Jul-2024-Jun-2025, down from 51.7% in 2021/22.
facts.publisher: JICA (citing MWI 3rd National NRW Assessment Report)

facts.claim_en: Utility NRW 2022: Miyahuna 42.8%, Aqaba Water 33.1%, Yarmouk Water 51.1%
facts.claim_ar: فاقد الشركات 2022: مياهنا 42.8% والعقبة 33.1% واليرموك 51.1%
facts.safe_en: Per the regulator (UPMU), 2022 NRW was 42.8% at Miyahuna, 33.1% at Aqaba Water and 51.1% at Yarmouk Water.

facts.claim_en: Highest-NRW governorates (FY2024/25): Mafraq 67.5%, Balqa 60.5%, Tafilah 56.1%, Ma'an 53.9%
facts.claim_ar: أعلى المحافظات فاقدًا: المفرق 67.5% والبلقاء 60.5%
facts.safe_en: Mafraq (67.5%) and Balqa (60.5%) had the highest non-revenue water in 2024/25; Aqaba the lowest (33.4%).

facts.claim_en: King Abdullah Canal: illegal extraction is 57% of canal water loss (~28 MCM, 2021); seepage 40% (~20 MCM)
facts.claim_ar: قناة الملك عبدالله: الاستخراج غير المشروع 57% من فاقد القناة
facts.safe_en: In 2021 about 27% of all water entering the Jordan Valley system (from sources and dams to irrigation networks) was lost; illegal extraction made up about 57% (~28 MCM) of King Abdullah Canal losses.

facts.claim_en: Amman UFW fell from 54% (1999) to 42% (2006) under the LEMA management contract
facts.claim_ar: انخفض الفاقد في عمّان من 54% إلى 42% (1999-2006)
facts.safe_en: Under the 1999-2006 management contract, Amman's unaccounted-for water fell from 54% to 42%.

facts.claim_en: Acceptable NRW for a similar operating environment is ~20%
facts.claim_ar: الفاقد المقبول في بيئة مشابهة نحو 20%
facts.safe_en: The World Bank compares Jordan's ~50% NRW with an acceptable level of about 20% for similar conditions.

facts.claim_en: WB Water Sector Efficiency Project: US$209m for NRW; target 10 MCM/yr of NRW reduction by Nov-2028 (0 achieved at Sep-2024)
facts.claim_ar: مشروع البنك الدولي: 209 ملايين دولار للفاقد
facts.safe_en: World Bank financing includes US$209 million for NRW reduction, targeting 10 million m³ a year of reduced losses by 2028.

facts.claim_en: IBNET Jordan sample NRW: 43% (2008), 42% (2009), 36% (2010)
facts.claim_ar: عينة IBNET للأردن: الفاقد 43% و42% و36%
facts.safe_en: IBNET's Jordan sample reported NRW of 43% (2008) falling to 36% (2010).

facts.claim_en: Zarqa: restructured-network areas have NRW 35.5% vs 70.4% in old-network areas
facts.claim_ar: الزرقاء: الفاقد 35.5% في الشبكة الجديدة مقابل 70.4% في القديمة
facts.safe_en: In Zarqa, areas with a rebuilt network had about half the NRW of old-network areas (35.5% vs 70.4%).

facts.claim_en: GRACE: Jordan terrestrial water storage declined ~0.9 cm/yr (2002-2026)
facts.claim_ar: غريس: تراجع مخزون المياه الكلي فوق الأردن ~0.9 سم/سنة
facts.safe_en: Satellite gravity (GRACE) shows total water storage over Jordan falling about 0.9 cm per year since 2002 (illustrative, regional).

facts.claim_en: Aqueduct 4.0: Jordan baseline water stress is 'Extremely High (>80%)'
facts.claim_ar: أكوادكت: الإجهاد المائي في الأردن مرتفع للغاية
facts.safe_en: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 ranks Jordan's baseline water stress 'Extremely High' (>80% of supply withdrawn).

facts.claim_en: SDG 6.4.2: Jordan's level of water stress is 105.2% (2023)
facts.claim_ar: مؤشر 6.4.2: الإجهاد المائي في الأردن 105.2% (2023)
facts.safe_en: Jordan withdraws more freshwater than is renewably available: SDG 6.4.2 water stress was 105% in 2022 (country data); the 2023 figure is an FAO estimate with the same value.

facts.claim_en: SDG 6.1.1: 89.0% of Jordan's population uses safely managed drinking water (2024)
facts.claim_ar: مؤشر 6.1.1: 89.0% مياه شرب مُدارة بأمان
facts.safe_en: 89% of people in Jordan use safely managed drinking water (JMP modelled estimate, 2024).

facts.claim_en: AQUASTAT: total renewable water resources per capita 81.9 m3/yr (2023)
facts.claim_ar: الموارد المائية المتجددة للفرد 81.9 م³/سنة
facts.safe_en: Jordan has about 82 m³ of renewable water per person per year (FAO estimate, 2023).

facts.claim_en: USGS: groundwater levels in six basins fell ~1 m/yr (2010); 30-40% of saturated thickness forecast depleted by 2030
facts.claim_ar: هبوط منسوب المياه الجوفية نحو متر سنويًا
facts.safe_en: USGS found groundwater levels in Jordan's six main groundwater basins falling on average about 1 m per year in 2010.

facts.claim_en: MWI/BGR 2017: groundwater abstraction exceeds natural recharge in nearly all aquifers
facts.claim_ar: السحب من المياه الجوفية يفوق التغذية في معظم الأحواض
facts.safe_en: The 2017 national groundwater assessment found abstraction exceeds recharge in nearly all aquifers.

facts.claim_en: Greater Amman 1987: UFW 59% = physical 21% (leakage 19 + transmission 2) + administrative 38%
facts.claim_ar: عمّان 1987: فاقد 59% منه 21% فيزيائي و38% إداري
facts.safe_en: A consultant study of Greater Amman's 1987 water balance found 59% unaccounted-for water, of which only 21 points were physical losses.

facts.claim_en: In some utilities up to 80% of NRW-related data are estimates rather than measurements
facts.claim_ar: حتى 80% من بيانات الفاقد تقديرية في بعض الشركات
facts.safe_en: In some Jordanian utilities up to 80% of NRW data are estimated rather than measured (JICA 2026).

facts.claim_en: NRW costs WAJ and the three utilities ~JOD 350 million per year; >JOD 1 bn NRW investment secured 2021-2030 (USAID >US$300m, KfW >EUR150m)
facts.claim_ar: الفاقد يكلّف نحو 350 مليون دينار سنويًا
facts.safe_en: Water losses cost Jordan's water sector an estimated JOD 350 million a year.

facts.claim_en: National NRW Strategy needs JOD 1,272m over 10 years (physical losses JOD 1,079.5m)
facts.claim_ar: استراتيجية الفاقد تحتاج 1.27 مليار دينار
facts.safe_en: Jordan's NRW strategy is costed at about JOD 1.27 billion over 10 years, 85% for physical-loss works.

facts.claim_en: IFC is structuring a performance-based NRW PPP for one third of Amman (agreement 6 June 2024)
facts.claim_ar: مؤسسة التمويل الدولية: عقد أداء لخفض الفاقد في ثلث عمّان
facts.safe_en: IFC agreed (June 2024) to co-develop with the Government and Miyahuna a private-investment project, to be tendered competitively, to cut water loss across about one third of Amman's area.

facts.claim_en: Long-run governorate NRW series 1995-2016 (MWI): national 55.5% (1995) -> 50.0% (2016), low of 42% (2011)
facts.claim_ar: سلسلة الفاقد حسب المحافظة 1995-2016
facts.safe_en: MWI data show national NRW at 55.5% in 1995 and 50.0% in 2016, never below 42%.

facts.claim_en: ESA WorldCover maps 3,100 km2 of cropland in Jordan in 2020 and 2,611 km2 in 2021 (3.5% and 2.9% of the country).
facts.claim_ar: تُظهر WorldCover نحو 3,100 كم² أراضي زراعية في الأردن عام 2020 و2,611 كم² عام 2021 (3.5% و2.9%).
facts.safe_en: WorldCover maps roughly 2,600-3,100 km2 of cropland in Jordan; the drop from 2020 to 2021 is mostly a change of algorithm, not of farming.

facts.claim_en: WorldCover cropland in Mafraq fell from 918 km2 (2020) to 645 km2 (2021).
facts.claim_ar: انخفضت الأراضي الزراعية في المفرق حسب WorldCover من 918 إلى 645 كم².
facts.safe_en: Do not read WorldCover 2020 vs 2021 as change; use one version, or a consistent annual series.

facts.claim_en: WorldCover is free to use under CC BY 4.0.
facts.claim_ar: بيانات WorldCover مجانية برخصة CC BY 4.0.
facts.safe_en: ESA WorldCover (CC BY 4.0) - attribution required.

facts.claim_en: WorldCover 2021 global overall accuracy is 76.7%.
facts.claim_ar: الدقة الكلية العالمية لـ WorldCover 2021 هي 76.7%.
facts.safe_en: WorldCover 2021 is about 77% accurate globally; it is a context layer, not ground truth.

facts.claim_en: WaPOR v3 data can be downloaded without any API key or account.
facts.claim_ar: يمكن تنزيل بيانات WaPOR v3 دون مفتاح أو حساب.
facts.safe_en: FAO WaPOR v3 is open: no key, token or account is needed.

facts.claim_en: WaPOR v3 Level-2 (100 m) annual and monthly actual evapotranspiration covers all of Jordan for 2018-2025.
facts.claim_ar: تغطي بيانات WaPOR v3 بدقة 100 م الأردن بالكامل للأعوام 2018-2025.
facts.safe_en: FAO's 100 m evapotranspiration maps cover all of Jordan every year since 2018 and every month to September 2026.

facts.claim_en: DoS: irrigated area in Jordan was 963,521 dunum (963.5 km2) in 2025; rainfed 728,712 dunum.
facts.claim_ar: دائرة الإحصاءات: المساحة المروية 963,521 دونم (963.5 كم²) عام 2025 والبعلية 728,712 دونم.
facts.safe_en: Jordan irrigates a little under 1,000 km2 of cropped area (DoS 2025).

facts.claim_en: The 2017 agricultural census and the 2017 annual survey give the same national irrigated area.
facts.claim_ar: يتطابق التعداد الزراعي 2017 مع المسح السنوي 2017 في المساحة المروية.
facts.safe_en: Census and survey agree on 865 km2 irrigated in 2017.

facts.claim_en: Recorded groundwater abstraction for agriculture was 246.5 MCM in 2025 from 2,672 wells (235.7 MCM in 2019).
facts.claim_ar: بلغ الضخ الجوفي المسجل للزراعة 246.5 م.م³ عام 2025 من 2,672 بئراً (235.7 عام 2019).
facts.safe_en: Officially recorded agricultural groundwater pumping is about 220-265 MCM a year (2019-2025).

facts.claim_en: Remote sensing estimated 375 MCM of irrigation groundwater pumping in 2019 against 235 MCM reported.
facts.claim_ar: قدّر الاستشعار عن بعد ضخ 375 م.م³ من المياه الجوفية للري عام 2019 مقابل 235 م.م³ مُبلّغ عنها.
facts.safe_en: A peer-reviewed study estimated irrigation pumping about 60% above the recorded figure (2019).

facts.claim_en: Remote sensing mapped 98 thousand ha irrigated in 2019; DoS recorded 80 thousand ha (800,565 dunum).
facts.claim_ar: رصد الاستشعار 98 ألف هكتار مروية عام 2019 مقابل 80 ألفاً في سجلات الإحصاءات.
facts.safe_en: Satellite mapping finds more irrigated land than the statistics (about +20% in 2019).

facts.claim_en: Groundwater abstraction in 2023 was 699 MCM against a safe yield of 419 MCM (deficit 281 MCM).
facts.claim_ar: بلغ الضخ الجوفي 699 م.م³ عام 2023 مقابل حد آمن 419 م.م³ (عجز 281).
facts.safe_en: MWI reports groundwater pumping about 280 MCM above safe yield in 2023.

facts.claim_en: Azraq basin: 60 MCM abstracted in 2023 against a safe yield of 24 MCM.
facts.claim_ar: حوض الأزرق: ضخ 60 م.م³ عام 2023 مقابل حد آمن 24 م.م³.
facts.safe_en: Azraq is pumped at about 2.5 times its safe yield (MWI 2023).

facts.claim_en: Jordan had 3,438 operating wells in 2023 (2,335 agricultural); the same booklet's key facts say more than 3,454.
facts.claim_ar: عدد الآبار العاملة 3,438 عام 2023 منها 2,335 زراعية؛ وفي الحقائق الرئيسية للكتيب نفسه أكثر من 3,454.
facts.safe_en: About 3,450 wells operate in Jordan, two-thirds of them for agriculture (2023).

facts.claim_en: MWI's yearly series records 1,718 illegal wells backfilled in 2013-2023 (1,443 in 2013-2020).
facts.claim_ar: تسجل سلسلة الوزارة السنوية ردم 1,718 بئراً مخالفة في 2013-2023 (1,443 في 2013-2020).
facts.safe_en: MWI has backfilled well over 1,000 illegal wells since 2013; counts differ between MWI publications.

facts.claim_en: IWMI (from MWI annual report) counts 1,293 illegal wells closed up to 2016, with 385 in 2014.
facts.claim_ar: يحصي تقرير IWMI إغلاق 1,293 بئراً مخالفة حتى 2016، منها 385 عام 2014.
facts.safe_en: Cite illegal-well counts with their source and cut-off date; MWI sources disagree.

facts.claim_en: MWI (Nov 2024): 201 illegal wells backfilled in 2023-2024; 1,593 in total since 2013.
facts.claim_ar: الوزارة (تشرين الثاني 2024): ردم 201 بئر مخالفة في 2023-2024 و1,593 منذ 2013.
facts.safe_en: MWI reported about 1,600 illegal wells backfilled 2013-2024 (press statement).

facts.claim_en: Brief: the ministry shut down 1,213 illegal wells (2013 to April 2021).
facts.claim_ar: الملخص: أغلقت الوزارة 1,213 بئراً مخالفة (2013 - نيسان 2021).
facts.safe_en: MWI has closed more than 1,200 illegal wells since 2013 (its own series gives about 1,450-1,700 depending on the cut-off).

facts.claim_en: In 2015, 3,138 known (licensed and unlicensed) wells abstracted 624.7 MCM, 130% of safe yield.
facts.claim_ar: عام 2015 ضخت 3,138 بئراً معروفة (مرخصة وغير مرخصة) 624.7 م.م³، أي 130% من الحد الآمن.
facts.safe_en: Official well statistics include known unlicensed wells, not unknown ones.

facts.claim_en: Azraq wells have three legal statuses: licensed, registered-illegal (permitted), and unregistered illegal.
facts.claim_ar: لآبار الأزرق ثلاث حالات قانونية: مرخصة، ومخالفة مسجلة (بتصريح)، ومخالفة غير مسجلة.
facts.safe_en: A farm on a flagged patch may draw from a licensed or a permitted well: a flag is never proof of theft.

facts.claim_en: In Azraq, actual agricultural groundwater use exceeds three times the official records (surveys cited by IWMI).
facts.claim_ar: في الأزرق يتجاوز الاستخدام الزراعي الفعلي للمياه الجوفية ثلاثة أضعاف السجلات الرسمية.
facts.safe_en: Surveys found Azraq farm water use far above recorded figures (IWMI citing Al-Bakri 2015, USAID 2014).

facts.claim_en: Large Mafraq (North Badia) farms studied by IWMI were all on legal land with legal wells.
facts.claim_ar: مزارع المفرق الكبيرة التي درسها IWMI كلها على أراض وآبار قانونية.
facts.safe_en: IWMI (2016) found that the large deep-well investor farms it studied in Mafraq were all on legal land with legal wells: such farms are a likely source of false positives.

facts.claim_en: GMIA v5 (c. 2005) puts 81,510 ha equipped for irrigation in Jordan, 56% of it groundwater-fed (our overlay).
facts.claim_ar: تقدّر GMIA v5 (حوالي 2005) المساحة المجهزة للري بـ81,510 هكتاراً، 56% منها من المياه الجوفية.
facts.safe_en: Global maps put Jordan's irrigated area at 80,000-100,000 ha (2005-2015).

facts.claim_en: HID gives 98,047 ha equipped for irrigation in Jordan in 2015 (our overlay).
facts.claim_ar: تعطي HID مساحة 98,047 هكتاراً مجهزة للري عام 2015.
facts.safe_en: A global map (HID, coarse ~9 km cells) puts the area equipped for irrigation in Jordan at about 98,000 ha in 2015.

facts.claim_en: FAOSTAT's 2024 'land area equipped for irrigation' (91.24 thousand ha) equals DoS irrigated area exactly.
facts.claim_ar: رقم FAOSTAT للمساحة المجهزة للري 2024 يساوي تماماً رقم دائرة الإحصاءات.
facts.safe_en: FAOSTAT is not an independent check on DoS for Jordan.

facts.claim_en: WaPOR 'irrigated-like' land (AETI minus rain > 250 mm/yr, open water excluded) was 931 km2 in 2024 vs DoS 912 km2 irrigated.
facts.claim_ar: مساحة الأراضي «الشبيهة بالمروية» من WaPOR بلغت 931 كم² عام 2024 مقابل 912 كم² في الإحصاءات.
facts.safe_en: In dry years, satellite evapotranspiration picks out an irrigated area close to the official figure; in wet years the simple rule undercounts.
facts.publisher: computed from FAO WaPOR v3 + ESA WorldCover

facts.claim_en: Dry-land patches with new sustained evapotranspiration (2023-25 vs 2018-20) total about 5,960 ha in 237 patches; the largest are near Mudawwara (Maan).
facts.claim_ar: بقع جديدة مستدامة التبخر في الأراضي الجافة بنحو 5,960 هكتاراً في 237 بقعة، أكبرها قرب المدورة (معان).
facts.safe_en: FAO WaPOR data (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) already show where irrigation appeared or intensified in Jordan's dry land since 2020 - each one is a site worth checking, not an accusation.

facts.claim_en: The Jordan Valley Authority has granted about 400 well licences (saline wells up to 150 m deep).
facts.claim_ar: منحت سلطة وادي الأردن نحو 400 رخصة بئر (آبار مالحة بعمق أقصى 150 م).
facts.safe_en: New licensed wells in the Jordan Valley mean new legitimate irrigation that can look like a new green patch.

facts.claim_en: DoS wells-by-basin table: 2019 has no Dead Sea value and a one-off 'Mujib' row of 467.
facts.claim_ar: جدول الآبار حسب الحوض: عام 2019 بلا قيمة للبحر الميت وصف «الموجب» 467 لمرة واحدة.
facts.safe_en: In DoS's 2019 wells-by-basin table the Dead Sea basin appears to be listed as 'Mujib' (467 wells); treat 2019 basin counts with care.

facts.claim_en: DoS counts of operating wells jump from 3,512 (2024) to 3,938 (2025); agricultural wells 2,378 to 2,672.
facts.claim_ar: قفز عدد الآبار العاملة من 3,512 (2024) إلى 3,938 (2025)، والزراعية من 2,378 إلى 2,672.
facts.safe_en: Registered agricultural wells rose by about 300 in 2025.

facts.claim_en: MWI groundwater policy: safe yield about 277 MCM/yr; 2021 pumping exceeded it by more than 172 MCM.
facts.claim_ar: سياسة المياه الجوفية: الحد الآمن نحو 277 م.م³ سنوياً وتجاوزه الضخ عام 2021 بأكثر من 172 م.م³.
facts.safe_en: MWI's groundwater policy puts the safe yield at about 277 MCM/yr and says 2021 pumping exceeded it by more than 172 MCM.

facts.claim_en: Al-Bakri et al. (2016): over-abstraction 144%-360% of safe yield in Yarmouk, Amman-Zarqa and Azraq; overlays exposed unlicensed wells.
facts.claim_ar: الباكري 2016: الضخ الزائد 144%-360% من الحد الآمن في اليرموك وعمان-الزرقاء والأزرق.
facts.safe_en: Overlaying satellite irrigation maps on well records has already helped MWI find unlicensed wells.

facts.claim_en: OSM governorates leave 408 km2 of Jordan's polygon uncovered: Dead Sea and Gulf of Aqaba water.
facts.claim_ar: حدود المحافظات في OSM تترك 408 كم² خارجها: مياه البحر الميت وخليج العقبة.
facts.safe_en: Our OSM governorate polygons cover all of Jordan's land; the 408 km2 they leave out is Dead Sea and Gulf of Aqaba water.

facts.claim_en: Agricultural census 2017: 2,410 holdings use artesian wells as irrigation source, with 664,895 dunum of holding area.
facts.claim_ar: التعداد الزراعي 2017: 2,410 حيازات تعتمد على الآبار الارتوازية للري، بمساحة حيازات 664,895 دونماً.
facts.safe_en: About 2,400 farm holdings irrigate from deep (artesian) wells - roughly one per registered agricultural well.

facts.claim_en: Five farming corporations were licensed in the Disi-Mudawwara area with a total licensed area of 11,676 ha (2013 inventory).
facts.claim_ar: خمس شركات زراعية مرخصة في منطقة الديسي-المدورة بمساحة مرخصة إجمالية 11,676 هكتاراً (جرد 2013).
facts.safe_en: In 2013 five farming corporations held licences for 11,676 ha in the Disi-Mudawwara area: large pivots there may be licensed corporate farms and must be checked against those concessions before any flag.
facts.publisher: UN-ESCWA and BGR, Inventory of Shared Water Resources in Western Asia, ch. 10

facts.claim_en: Agricultural abstraction from the Disi (Ram) aquifer was about 40 MCM/yr around 2012; DoS records 59.5 MCM in 2023 and 55.4 MCM in 2025.
facts.claim_ar: الضخ الزراعي من حوض الديسي نحو 40 م.م³ سنوياً حوالي 2012، وتسجل الإحصاءات 59.5 م.م³ عام 2023 و55.4 عام 2025.
facts.safe_en: Recorded agricultural groundwater pumping from the Disi basin roughly doubled between 2015-2019 (26-29 MCM/yr) and 2022-2025 (54-60 MCM/yr) (DoS/MWI).
facts.publisher: UN-ESCWA and BGR (2013); DoS Abs_6 (MWI data)

facts.claim_en: On 16 August 2026 the Cabinet approved an amended Groundwater Control Regulation (of 2026) that lets agricultural wells already irrigating crops be regularised until early June 2027 and adds smart water meters.
facts.claim_ar: أقرّ مجلس الوزراء في 16 آب 2026 نظاماً معدِّلاً لنظام مراقبة المياه الجوفية لسنة 2026 يسمح بتصويب أوضاع الآبار الزراعية القائمة عليها زراعات حتى مطلع حزيران 2027 ويضيف عدادات مياه ذكية.
facts.safe_en: Until June 2027 Jordan is regularising agricultural wells that already irrigate crops: a farm whose well is unlicensed today may be licensed soon, so licence status must be checked at the time of any flag.

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna water network length in 2023, by governorate: Amman 10,639 km, Zarqa 4,035 km, Madaba 1,520 km, Balqa 2,363.762 km (sum 18,557.8 km).
facts.claim_ar: أطوال شبكات المياه لدى مياهنا 2023: العاصمة 10,639 كم، الزرقاء 4,035، مادبا 1,520، البلقاء 2,363.762 (المجموع 18,557.8 كم).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna reports about 18,600 km of water mains across Amman, Zarqa, Madaba and Balqa in 2023 (Amman alone: 10,639 km).

facts.claim_en: Amman water network length grew from 10,172 km (2019) to 10,639 km (2023).
facts.claim_ar: طول شبكة مياه العاصمة ارتفع من 10,172 كم (2019) إلى 10,639 كم (2023).
facts.safe_en: Amman's mapped water network grew about 4.6% in four years, to 10,639 km in 2023.

facts.claim_en: The 2022 dataset 'Water Network Length' (10,172-10,422 km) is Miyahuna's total network.
facts.claim_ar: مجموعة «أطوال شبكات المياه 2022» (10,172-10,422 كم) هي إجمالي شبكة مياهنا.
facts.safe_en: Use the 2023 file: the 2022 file covers Amman only.

facts.claim_en: Amman GIS database water mains: 9,282,868 m (2015) to 10,179,977 m (2020); house connections 151,649 to 182,531.
facts.claim_ar: شبكات المياه على قاعدة البيانات الجغرافية في العاصمة: 9,282,868 م (2015) ثم 10,179,977 م (2020)؛ الوصلات المنزلية من 151,649 إلى 182,531.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna's GIS held about 10,180 km of water mains and 182,531 house connections in Amman at end-2020.

facts.claim_en: In 2020 Miyahuna used DGPS and Georadar to locate non-visible water and sewer networks for maintenance offices in 40 cases.
facts.claim_ar: استخدمت مياهنا عام 2020 تقنية DGPS وجهاز Georadar لتحديد شبكات مياه وصرف صحي غير ظاهرة بواقع 40 حالة.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna's 2020 report records 40 cases in which DGPS and ground-penetrating radar (Georadar) were used to locate water and sewer pipes that were not visible, in support of maintenance offices.

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna sewer network length 2023: Amman 3,721 km, Zarqa 1,461 km, Madaba 164 km, Balqa 694 km.
facts.claim_ar: أطوال شبكات الصرف الصحي 2023: العاصمة 3,721 كم، الزرقاء 1,461، مادبا 164، البلقاء 694.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna reports about 6,040 km of sewers in 2023.

facts.claim_en: Non-revenue water in Amman (Miyahuna KPI) was 39.15% of system input in 2022 (quarters: 43.0, 46.2, 33.9, 33.6).
facts.claim_ar: الفاقد (المياه غير المحاسب عليها) في العاصمة 39.15% من المدخلات عام 2022 حسب مؤشرات أداء مياهنا.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna's 2022 KPI sheet puts Amman's non-revenue water at 39.15% of system input.

facts.claim_en: Non-revenue water 2022: Zarqa 51.1%, Madaba 43.7%; 2021: Amman 39.85%, Zarqa 54.23%, Madaba 42.35%.
facts.claim_ar: الفاقد 2022: الزرقاء 51.1%، مادبا 43.7%؛ 2021: العاصمة 39.85%، الزرقاء 54.23%، مادبا 42.35%.
facts.safe_en: In 2022 about half of Zarqa's system input (51.1%) was non-revenue water; Madaba 43.7%.

facts.claim_en: About half of Jordan's water loss is physical leaks; the other half is administrative (brief, section 1).
facts.claim_ar: نحو نصف الفاقد تسربات فيزيائية والنصف الآخر إداري (الموجز، القسم 1).
facts.unit: share of NRW that is real loss
facts.safe_en: In Miyahuna's 2022 KPIs, physical (real) losses are about 37% of non-revenue water in Amman and about 46-47% in Zarqa and Madaba.

facts.claim_en: Amman supply is intermittent: the system is pressurized 21.4% of hours and 2.3% of subscribers get continuous supply (2022).
facts.claim_ar: التزويد متقطع في العاصمة: النظام مضغوط 21.4% من الساعات و2.3% فقط من المشتركين يحصلون على تزويد مستمر (2022).
facts.safe_en: In 2022 Amman's network was pressurized about 21% of the time; only 2.3% of subscribers had 24/7 supply.

facts.claim_en: 'No water' complaints per 1,000 active subscribers in 2022: Amman 365.5, Zarqa 379.3, Madaba 309.7.
facts.claim_ar: شكاوى انقطاع المياه لكل 1000 مشترك فعال 2022: العاصمة 365.5، الزرقاء 379.3، مادبا 309.7.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna logged about 0.37 'no water' complaints per active subscriber in Amman in 2022.

facts.claim_en: Active leakage control covered 10.1% of Amman's mains in 2022; metering ratio 90.6%; losses 25.7 m3/km/day.
facts.claim_ar: شمل الكشف النشط عن التسرب 10.1% من خطوط العاصمة عام 2022؛ نسبة العدادات 90.6%؛ الفاقد 25.7 م3/كم/يوم.
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna's 2022 KPI sheet reports active leakage control on about a tenth of Amman's mains (10.1% for the year; the quarterly figures add up to 7.6%).

facts.claim_en: Amman non-revenue water fell from 41.9% (2006) to 32.1% (2012); 2008 is 36.8% in the 2012 report but 37.3% in the 2008 report.
facts.claim_ar: انخفض فاقد العاصمة من 41.9% (2006) إلى 32.1% (2012)؛ قيمة 2008 هي 36.8% في تقرير 2012 و37.3% في تقرير 2008.
facts.safe_en: In Miyahuna's own series, Amman's NRW fell from 41.9% (2006) to 32.1% (2011-2012), then rose again to 37-41% (2014-2021).

facts.claim_en: Breaks per km of network (mains and house connections), Amman: 4.27 (2013), 4.04 (2014), 3.73 (2015), 3.41 (2016), 3.12 (2018), 3.65 (2021).
facts.safe_en: Amman records about 3.1-4.3 pipe breaks per km of network per year (2013-2021).

facts.claim_en: Illegal-use seizures recorded by Miyahuna in Amman: 2,919 (2017), 2,418 (2020), 3,559 (2021).
facts.claim_ar: ضبوطات الاستعمال غير المشروع في العاصمة: 2,919 (2017)، 2,418 (2020)، 3,559 (2021).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna's illegal-use unit wrote up 2,400-3,600 seizures a year in Amman (2017-2021), with 0.96-2.9 million m3 estimated per year.

facts.claim_en: Illegal-use cases detected in Amman: 8,448 (2008), 4,543 (2012), 5,434 (2013), 4,343 (2014; the 2015 report gives 4,689 seizures for 2014), 3,832 (2015).
facts.claim_ar: حالات الاستعمال غير المشروع المكتشفة في العاصمة: 8,448 (2008)، 4,543 (2012)، 5,434 (2013)، 4,343 (2014؛ وتقرير 2015 يذكر 4,689 ضبطاً لعام 2014)، 3,832 (2015).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna detected several thousand illegal-use cases a year in Amman between 2008 and 2015 (3,800-8,400).

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna's 2013 and 2014 reports show illegal underground pipes drawn from an 800 mm transmission main to irrigate farms and sell water by tanker (Al-Jiza, Al-Qastal).
facts.claim_ar: يُظهر تقريرا مياهنا 2013 و2014 سحب خطوط تحت الأرض من خط ناقل قطر 800 ملم لري المزارع وبيع المياه بالصهاريج (الجيزة، القسطل).
facts.safe_en: The utility's own reports document theft by underground taps on an 800 mm transmission main feeding farms south of Amman.

facts.claim_en: A 6-week campaign with Public Security from June 2013 removed attacks on lines in south Amman (Um al-Amad, Umm Rumana, Jiza, Al-Laban, Al-Muwaqqar): 344 seizures, > 275 thousand m3.
facts.claim_ar: حملة لستة أسابيع مع الأمن العام من حزيران 2013 جنوب عمان (أم العمد، أم رمانة، الجيزة، اللبن، الموقر): 344 ضبطاً وأكثر من 275 ألف م3.
facts.safe_en: In 2013 a six-week joint campaign with Public Security in south Amman recorded about 344 illegal-use seizures on transmission, distribution and service lines.

facts.claim_en: Non-visible leak sites located in Amman: 3,574 (2020) and 4,394 (2021).
facts.claim_ar: مواقع تسرب غير مرئي حُددت في العاصمة: 3,574 (2020) و4,394 (2021).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna's leak teams located about 3,600-4,400 hidden leaks a year in Amman (2020-2021).

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna reported NRW by district metered area (DMA) in Amman, e.g. 2021 baselines: Hashmi Lower 63.64%, Abu Alanda 57.23%, Qweismeh 42.75%, Marka 18.30%.
facts.claim_ar: أعلنت مياهنا الفاقد حسب مناطق التوزيع الفرعية في العاصمة، مثلاً خط الأساس 2021: الهاشمي السفلي 63.64%، أبو علندا 57.23%، القويسمة 42.75%، ماركا 18.30%.
facts.safe_en: Area-level loss figures exist in Miyahuna's annual reports (2016-2021) for named Amman zones; they show baselines from under 20% to over 70%.

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna operating wells 2023: Amman 51, Zarqa 63, Madaba 17, Balqa 18 (149).
facts.claim_ar: آبار مياهنا العاملة 2023: العاصمة 51، الزرقاء 63، مادبا 17، البلقاء 18 (149).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna ran 149 wells in 2023.

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna reservoirs 2023: Amman 78 (728,650 m3), Zarqa 16 (87,850 m3), Madaba 5 (20,500 m3), Balqa 24 (20,900 m3).
facts.claim_ar: خزانات مياهنا 2023: العاصمة 78 (728,650 م3)، الزرقاء 16 (87,850)، مادبا 5 (20,500)، البلقاء 24 (20,900).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna lists 123 reservoirs with about 858,000 m3 maximum storage in 2023.

facts.claim_ar: الاتصالات الواردة لمركز الشكاوى والتحكم: 2,086,166 (2019) ... 1,740,793 (2023).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna's complaints and control center received 1.7-2.4 million calls a year (2019-2023).

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna water subscribers: 707,192 (2018) to 794,280 (2022).
facts.claim_ar: عدد المشتركين بالمياه لدى مياهنا: 707,192 (2018) إلى 794,280 (2022).
facts.safe_en: Miyahuna had about 794,000 water subscribers in 2022.

facts.claim_en: Water supplied 2023: Amman 221,065,304 m3, Zarqa 61,861,425, Madaba 11,199,893, Balqa 38,184,086; Disi water (Miyahuna) 110,981,826 m3.
facts.claim_ar: كميات التزويد 2023: العاصمة 221,065,304 م3، الزرقاء 61,861,425، مادبا 11,199,893، البلقاء 38,184,086؛ مياه الديسي (مياهنا) 110,981,826 م3.
facts.safe_en: Amman's supply volume was about 221 million m3 in 2023; Miyahuna's Disi intake was about 111 million m3.

facts.claim_en: Jordan had 3,417 producing wells in 2022, abstracting 659.25 MCM; 2,307 are private irrigation wells (236.24 MCM).
facts.claim_ar: بلغ عدد الآبار المنتجة في الأردن 3,417 بئراً عام 2022 بإنتاج 659.25 م م3؛ منها 2,307 آبار ري خاصة (236.24 م م3).
facts.safe_en: MWI counts 3,417 producing wells in 2022; two thirds are private irrigation wells.

facts.claim_en: The MWI 2022 groundwater table's printed column totals match its basin rows.
facts.claim_ar: مجاميع أعمدة جدول المياه الجوفية 2022 تطابق صفوف الأحواض.
facts.safe_en: Use the basin rows and grand total (3,417 wells, 659.25 MCM); three printed column totals in the 2022 table are inconsistent.

facts.claim_en: Total water use in Jordan 2022: 1,130.49 MCM; municipal/tourism 517.65 (45.9%), irrigation 571.71 (50.5%); groundwater 659.25 MCM (58.2%).
facts.claim_ar: مجموع استخدامات المياه 2022: 1,130.49 م م3؛ البلدية والسياحية 517.65 (45.9%)، الري 571.71 (50.5%)؛ المياه الجوفية 659.25 (58.2%).
facts.safe_en: Jordan used about 1,130 MCM of water in 2022, 58% of it groundwater.

facts.claim_en: Water Authority Internal Control Unit, 2020: 43 violations of attacks on water lines, 10 private-well violations, 490 water complaints and control tours followed up.
facts.claim_ar: وحدة الرقابة الداخلية في سلطة المياه 2020: 43 مخالفة اعتداء على خطوط المياه، 10 مخالفات آبار خاصة، 490 شكوى وجولة رقابية.
facts.safe_en: The Water Authority's Internal Control Unit (the brief's first buyer) recorded 43 line-attack violations in 2020.
facts.publisher: MWI / Water Authority of Jordan / Jordan Valley Authority (joint annual report 2020)

facts.claim_en: Jordan Valley (Northern and Middle Ghor) violations 2020: 804 drawing water from the canal, 241 tampering, 33 water released without irrigation order, 18 violating farm units (1,096).
facts.claim_ar: مخالفات الأغوار الشمالية والوسطى 2020: 804 إسالة مياه من القناة، 241 عبث، 33 إسالة بدون أمر سقاية، 18 وحدة زراعية مخالفة (1,096).
facts.safe_en: JVA's 2020 report lists 804 cases of water drawn from the canal without authorisation in its northern Jordan Valley operations.
facts.publisher: MWI / Water Authority of Jordan / Jordan Valley Authority (joint annual report 2020)

facts.claim_en: JVA North Dead Sea attacks directorate, 2020 (cumulative): King Abdullah Canal violations 2,779, removals 578, drowning cases 7.
facts.claim_ar: مديرية اعتداءات شمال البحر الميت 2020: مخالفات على قناة الملك عبدالله 2,779، إزالات 578، حالات غرق 7.
facts.safe_en: In 2020 one JVA directorate alone recorded 2,779 violations on the King Abdullah Canal.
facts.publisher: MWI / Water Authority of Jordan / Jordan Valley Authority (joint annual report 2020)

facts.claim_en: Balqa water administration overall loss 2020: 71.3% (Salt 67.82%, Ain al-Basha 58.18%, South Shuneh 88.68%, Deir Alla 80.10%).
facts.claim_ar: الفاقد العام لإدارة مياه البلقاء 2020: 71.3% (السلط 67.82%، عين الباشا 58.18%، الشونة الجنوبية 88.68%، دير علا 80.10%).
facts.safe_en: Balqa's water administration reported 71.3% losses in 2020, up to 88.7% in South Shuneh.
facts.publisher: MWI / Water Authority of Jordan / Jordan Valley Authority (joint annual report 2020)

facts.claim_en: The ministry recorded 59,630 attempts to breach water pipelines plus 24,615 on the King Abdullah Canal (2013-Apr 2021) and closed 1,213 illegal wells (brief, section 1).
facts.claim_ar: سجلت الوزارة 59,630 محاولة اعتداء على خطوط المياه و24,615 على قناة الملك عبدالله (2013-نيسان 2021) وأغلقت 1,213 بئراً مخالفة (الموجز).
facts.safe_en: Do not cite opendata.gov.jo for the 59,630 figure; cite the news source and verify with the ministry.
facts.publisher: MWI / Water Authority of Jordan / Jordan Valley Authority (joint annual report 2020)

facts.claim_en: opendata.gov.jo lists 3,768 public datasets with 7,118 resources from 157 organisations (package_list: 3,779 names incl. 11 test/unpublished).
facts.claim_ar: تضم البوابة 3,768 مجموعة بيانات عامة و7,118 مورداً من 157 جهة (package_list: 3,779 اسماً منها 11 تجريبية/غير منشورة).
facts.safe_en: As of 9 Oct 2026 the portal lists 3,768 datasets from 157 publishers.

facts.claim_en: Water publishers on the portal: Miyahuna 131 datasets, MWI 17, Water Authority 10; Jordan Valley Authority 0; no Yarmouk or Aqaba water company organisation; Ministry of Environment 9 (all air quality); Ministry of Agriculture 8 (none on water).
facts.claim_ar: ناشرو قطاع المياه على البوابة: مياهنا 131، الوزارة 17، سلطة المياه 10؛ سلطة وادي الأردن 0؛ لا توجد شركة مياه اليرموك أو العقبة؛ البيئة 9 (كلها هواء)؛ الزراعة 8 (لا شيء عن المياه).
facts.safe_en: Only three water-sector bodies publish on opendata.gov.jo; Miyahuna accounts for 131 of 158 water-sector datasets.

facts.claim_en: All 3,768 datasets carry licence_id JORDONIAN-DEFAULT ('Open Jordonian License'), but the portal publishes no licence text: the licence page body is only its title and the terms page says content will be displayed later.
facts.claim_ar: تحمل كل المجموعات (3,768) الرخصة JORDONIAN-DEFAULT، لكن البوابة لا تنشر نص الرخصة: صفحة الرخصة تحتوي العنوان فقط، وصفحة الشروط تقول إن المحتوى سيُعرض لاحقاً.
facts.safe_en: Portal data are labelled with the Jordanian open licence, but its text is not on the portal; attribute the publisher and the licence name.

facts.claim_en: Licence text v1.0 (JOSA-MoICT final draft, 2019-03-04) lets users use, copy, publish, distribute, process and commercially exploit the work, if they attribute it; default attribution sentence given.
facts.claim_ar: نص الرخصة 1.0 (المسودة النهائية JOSA-الوزارة 4/3/2019) يتيح الاستخدام والنسخ والنشر والتوزيع والمعالجة والاستغلال التجاري بشرط النسب، مع جملة نسب افتراضية.
facts.safe_en: Per the 2019 draft licence, reuse incl. commercial use is allowed with attribution; confirm against the official text before relying on it.

facts.claim_en: Portal access quirks: HEAD requests get HTTP 403; package_search fails with GET and works with POST.
facts.claim_ar: خصائص الوصول: طلبات HEAD تُرفض 403؛ package_search يفشل بـ GET وينجح بـ POST.
facts.safe_en: Use POST for package_search and >=3 s between requests; HEAD works today.

facts.claim_en: Some '.xls' resources on the portal are really xlsx.
facts.claim_ar: بعض ملفات «.xls» على البوابة هي فعلياً xlsx.
facts.safe_en: Check magic bytes: 2 of the 82 water-related resources labelled XLS are xlsx (DoS irrigated areas).

facts.claim_en: Miyahuna's pumping-station SOPs on the portal give station coordinates and schematics (6 PDFs).
facts.claim_ar: إجراءات التشغيل المعيارية لمحطات الضخ المنشورة على البوابة تتضمن إحداثيات المحطات ومخططاتها (6 ملفات).
facts.safe_en: Openly published but sensitive: stored under restricted/, not to be used in demos.

facts.claim_en: OSM relation 184818 is Jordan's national boundary (admin_level 2)
facts.claim_ar: العلاقة 184818 في OSM هي حدود الأردن الوطنية
facts.safe_en: Jordan's boundary in OSM is relation 184818 (admin_level 2, ISO3166-1 JO).

facts.claim_en: The fresh Geofabrik extract contains OSM data up to 2026-10-08T20:21:06Z and its MD5 matches
facts.claim_ar: مستخرج Geofabrik الجديد يحوي بيانات حتى 2026-10-08 ومطابقة MD5
facts.safe_en: OSM snapshot of 8 Oct 2026 (Geofabrik).

facts.claim_en: Clipping to Jordan's boundary drops features of neighbouring countries from the Geofabrik extract
facts.claim_ar: قصّ المستخرج على حدود الأردن يحذف معالم من الدول المجاورة
facts.unit: object-layer records dropped (55 water-infrastructure, 168 agricultural, 185 natural-water); 38 Hebrew-named; 227 records cut at the border
facts.safe_en: About 400 water/agri features in the Geofabrik extract lie outside Jordan and were removed.

facts.claim_en: The King Abdullah Canal is about 110 km long
facts.claim_ar: طول قناة الملك عبدالله نحو 110 كم
facts.safe_en: The King Abdullah Canal is about 110 km long (National Water Strategy 2023-2040).

facts.claim_en: OSM maps 87.0 km of the KAC as one connected line of 48 ways; only 2 ways carry a name, with two different names
facts.claim_ar: OSM يرسم 87.0 كم من القناة كخط متصل من 48 مقطعًا؛ مقطعان فقط مسمّيان وباسمين مختلفين
facts.safe_en: OSM covers roughly four fifths of the KAC, mostly unnamed; the southern ~23 km are missing or disconnected.

facts.claim_en: The Disi conveyor is a ~325 km pipeline fed by 55 wells, 100 million m3/yr
facts.claim_ar: ناقل الديسي خط بطول نحو 325 كم يغذّيه 55 بئرًا بـ100 مليون م³/سنة
facts.safe_en: The Disi conveyor carries about 100 million m3 a year over roughly 325 km (Wikipedia; primary confirmation pending).

facts.claim_en: The Disi conveyor, the Disi well field, Zai WTP, Zara-Ma'in plant, Abu Alanda reservoir and any Aqaba desalination plant are absent from OSM
facts.claim_ar: ناقل الديسي وحقل آباره ومحطة الزي ومنظومة الزارة-ماعين وخزان أبو علندا وأي محطة تحلية في العقبة غير موجودة في OSM
facts.safe_en: OSM does not show Jordan's main water transmission system; route data must come from the utilities.

facts.claim_en: As-Samra WWTP was expanded to 365,000 m3/day
facts.claim_ar: توسعة محطة السمرا إلى 365,000 م³/يوم
facts.safe_en: As-Samra's design capacity is 365,000 m3/day after the Phase II expansion.

facts.claim_en: As-Samra received 410,643 m3/day in 2023, above its 365,000 m3/day design
facts.claim_ar: استقبلت السمرا 410,643 م³/يوم في 2023 فوق سعتها التصميمية
facts.safe_en: In 2023 As-Samra's actual inflow (about 411,000 m3/day) exceeded its design capacity (365,000 m3/day), per MWI.

facts.claim_en: Jordan's 14 main dams have a total design capacity of 356.8 MCM
facts.claim_ar: السعة التصميمية لـ14 سدًا رئيسيًا 356.8 مليون م³
facts.safe_en: MWI lists 14 main dams with 356.8 MCM design capacity (2023).

facts.claim_en: Al-Wehdah dam holds 115 million m3
facts.claim_ar: سعة سد الوحدة 115 مليون م³
facts.safe_en: Al-Wehdah's design capacity is 110 MCM (MWI).

facts.claim_en: Aqaba produced about 1.2 MCM of desalinated seawater in 2021
facts.claim_ar: إنتاج العقبة من تحلية مياه البحر نحو 1.2 مليون م³ في 2021
facts.safe_en: Seawater desalination in Aqaba was about 1.2 MCM in 2021, mostly for Aqaba and the fertiliser industry.

facts.claim_en: Jordan has 32 wastewater treatment plants
facts.claim_ar: في الأردن 32 محطة لمعالجة المياه العادمة
facts.safe_en: Jordan has 32 WWTPs (NWS 2023-2040). OSM has 38 wastewater-plant objects, not matched plant by plant, and only 4 carry a name tag.

facts.claim_en: The planned Aqaba-Amman project: desalination + 438 km conveyance, 300 MCM/yr
facts.claim_ar: الناقل الوطني: تحلية + 438 كم + 300 مليون م³/سنة
facts.safe_en: The planned national carrier will desalinate seawater in Aqaba and convey 300 MCM a year over about 438 km (AIIB).

facts.claim_en: OSM has 15 pipeline ways in Jordan (169.6 km); only 3 (about 2.3 km, Karak) are tagged as water
facts.claim_ar: في OSM 15 خط أنابيب في الأردن (169.6 كم)؛ 3 فقط (نحو 2.3 كم في الكرك) موسومة كمياه
facts.safe_en: OSM contains almost no water pipelines in Jordan.

facts.claim_en: Wikidata lists 238 water items in Jordan, none of them treatment, desalination, pumping or well items
facts.claim_ar: في ويكي بيانات 238 عنصرًا مائيًا في الأردن ليس بينها محطات معالجة أو تحلية أو ضخ أو آبار
facts.unit: items (210 springs, 23 dams, 3 reservoirs, 1 canal, 1 aqueduct)
facts.safe_en: Wikidata adds names and links for dams and springs but no utility plants.

facts.claim_en: Only 4 Wikidata water items are explicitly linked to OSM, and the Mujib dam link points to the reservoir item
facts.claim_ar: 4 عناصر فقط مرتبطة صراحةً بين ويكي بيانات وOSM، ورابط سد الموجب يشير إلى عنصر البحيرة
facts.safe_en: Only 4 Jordanian water items are explicitly linked between Wikidata and OSM, one of them to the wrong item; 78 of 238 items match by link, place or name.

facts.claim_en: Prior FORCAST: OSM has 0 pipelines in Amman governorate
facts.claim_ar: بحث FORCAST السابق: صفر أنابيب في محافظة عمّان
facts.safe_en: OSM shows no water pipeline network in Amman; one untyped pipeline crosses its eastern edge.

facts.claim_en: Between the 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-08 snapshots water-related OSM data barely changed
facts.claim_ar: بين لقطتي 12 أيلول و8 تشرين الأول تغيّرت بيانات المياه بالكاد
facts.value: +3 springs, +3 water points, +1 dam, +1 storage tank, -1 covered reservoir
facts.safe_en: OSM water data in Jordan changes by a handful of objects a month.

facts.claim_en: 939 of Mafraq's 941 OSM water points lie in the Za'atari camp area
facts.claim_ar: 939 من 941 نقطة مياه في المفرق تقع في منطقة مخيم الزعتري
facts.safe_en: OSM water points are dominated by one refugee camp's mapping and say nothing about the national network.

facts.claim_en: Almost no OSM object carries a water-utility operator tag
facts.claim_ar: لا يكاد أي معلم في OSM يحمل وسم مشغّل لجهة مياه
facts.unit: objects with operator = JVA / سلطة وادي الأردن; 0 with Miyahuna, WAJ, Yarmouk Water or Aqaba Water
facts.safe_en: OSM cannot tell which utility owns an asset.

facts.claim_en: OSM Jordan polygon area
facts.claim_ar: مساحة مضلّع الأردن في OSM
facts.unit: km2 (geodesic, WGS84; includes Dead Sea and Gulf of Aqaba waters); 408.4 km2 lies outside all 12 governorate polygons
